messages:
emma (DevEx): Quick note: onboarding flow in the nextjs-eval-starter is tripping new users. Two distinct issues: 1) SDK retry behavior duplicates outputs when eval harness retries a failed submission; 2) sample's README suggests using env var RW_KEY directly in serverless pages which causes intermittent 403s in Vercel preview.

raj (SDK): Can you paste the minimal repro for the duplication? Is this streaming or batch eval?

emma (DevEx): Batch eval harness (jest-based) that POSTs prompts to /api/eval-run. Sequence: initial POST returns 500 -> SDK retry resends and the harness records two completed results for the same run id. Simple harness snippet: ```js
// tests/eval-harness.spec.js
const res = await fetch('/api/eval-run', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({prompt, runId})})
expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({runId})
```
When server transiently errors we see two results with same runId in the evaluation dashboard.

olivia (Eng): Likely cause: our retryer replays the request but server-side handler doesn't dedupe by runId, and the SDK doesn't provide automatic idempotencyKey for eval submit. We added idempotency for generation earlier but missed eval endpoints.

raj (SDK): Good catch. Plan: add optional idempotencyKey to eval.submit() and generate() to send Idempotency-Key header. For compatibility we'll not enable by default, but the sample harness should demonstrate how to pass a UUID per run.

ben (QA): I can add a flaky test: mock server returns 500 then 200 and assert single recorded run for given runId. Also add an integration test that sets Idempotency-Key header.

emma (DevEx): Second issue: README tells people to put RW_KEY in Vercel env and reference directly in pages/server. New users hit 403s in previews. We should warn about serverless edge behavior and recommend server-side proxies or createClient({forceEdgeHeaders:true}). Example from repro: ```js
// app/api/eval/route.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
export async function POST(req) { return client.eval.submit({...}) }
```
On Vercel edge this sometimes strips Authorization header.

olivia (Eng): We saw this before — edge runtime header injection differs. SDK needs runtime detection (edge vs node) and fallback to fetch-compatible header injection. Short-term: update sample README with a snippet: ```js
// workaround
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, forceEdgeHeaders: true })
```
And add a migration note in the starter's troubleshooting section.

raj (SDK): I'll land two changes: 1) idempotencyKey support for eval endpoints + examples; 2) runtime detection and a RW_SDK_FORCE_EDGE env toggler. I'll push a canary build v0.11.4-canary-eval.

docs-bot: Created docs ticket DOCS-2023: "Eval starter - idempotency + edge auth guidance"

ben (QA): After SDK canary, I'll run the sample's full eval harness against staging and validate no duplicate runs when server errors are simulated.

emma (DevEx): Also adding a tiny note to the starter: "If your eval dashboard shows duplicate runs, enable idempotencyKey in your harness or set retry.maxRetries=0 while we roll the canary." Small snippet to include: ```js
await client.eval.submit({ prompt, metadata: { runId }, idempotencyKey: uuidv4() })
```

raj (SDK): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1842 (idempotency + edge detection). Will update example package.json to bump to canary in a follow-up.

olivia (Eng): I'll add server-side dedupe in the eval service as a safety net: ignore duplicate runId within 2 minutes. That prevents double-counts even if client doesn't set idempotency.

emma (DevEx): Great. Once canary is promoted we'll update the starter template and the quickstart onboarding checklist. Leaving this thread pinned until the QA pass completes. :white_check_mark:
